io.name: clk
io.description: Clock input; counter advances on posedge.

io.name: reset
io.description: Active-high synchronous reset; when asserted at a posedge, q becomes 0.

io.name: q
io.description: Decade counter output, counting 0 through 9 inclusive with period 10.

functional_summary.overview: A 4-bit decade counter that counts 0 through 9 inclusive and wraps to 0, giving a period of 10. The active-high synchronous reset forces the counter to 0 on the rising clock edge.
rules: On each posedge of clk, if reset is high, q is set to 0.
On each posedge of clk, if reset is low and q is 9, q is set to 0.
On each posedge of clk, if reset is low and q is less than 9, q is incremented by 1.
q only takes values 0 through 9; values 10 through 15 never occur in normal operation.
Output q updates one clock cycle after the sampled edge (registered output).
